_doc: Do thi phu thuoc DU PHONG cho aiops/diagnose.py (MANDATE-26).
CHI dung khi khong suy duoc tu spanmetrics (khong co Prometheus, hoac khop span_name
ra 0 canh). Khi phai dung, diagnose.py in ro `topology_source: static-fallback` kem
canh bao — khong bao gio xuong cap am tham.
`edges`: A -> B nghia la 'B hong thi A hong theo' (LAN LOI DONG BO). Do la quan he
duy nhat co ich cho RCA. Mot loi goi khong lan loi thi khong duoc dat vao day, du
trong so nguon van la mot phu thuoc.
`async_edges`: quan he QUA KAFKA. Ghi lai de nguoi doc biet chung ton tai, nhung CO Y
khong dua vao do thi nhan qua. Bang chung do duoc, khong phai suy doan: 26/07 giet
`payment` 367 giay -> ti le loi cua `checkout` dung nguyen 0.0000 suot 13/13 mau, vi
checkout day don vao topic roi tra ve ngay. Xem report/mandate15-eks/report.md muc 4.1.
Neu dat checkout -> payment vao `edges`, RCA se ket luan sai rang payment giai thich
duoc trang thai cua checkout.
NGUON: bien moi truong *_ADDR trong techx-corp-platform/src/<service>/ va cluster trong
frontend-proxy/envoy.tmpl.yaml, doc ngay 2026-07-29.
CANH BAO LOI THOI: file nay la anh chup mot thoi diem. Kien truc doi ma file khong doi
thi RCA se lap luan tren mot do thi sai — dung lop loi 'trong nhu dang canh nhung thuc
ra khong'. Vi du song: checkout -> payment tung la gRPC dong bo, chuyen sang Kafka
25/07. Uu tien luon la suy tu spanmetrics; file nay chi la luoi do.
